text: Overnight, Kamala Harris's price slid 0.6 points to 4.5, the largest change on the board. Most of that came on Kalshi, which moved 0.7 points, while Polymarket went the same way by 0.4 points. Kalshi's market on whether El-Sayed runs at all dropped 16 points, to 11 percent, even though El-Sayed's nomination price barely moved. It didn't change much in the model, where Harris finishes first in 5 percent of runs. AOC wins the most simulated primaries, 31 percent, though the betting favorite is Jon Ossoff at 26. In 10 percent of those runs nobody reaches the convention with a pledged majority. Watch the Harris price first when the books update tonight.
